ev_0005.summary: Semicircle figure: diameter BD (seg_01, y=347) with center O (304.4,346.6) and radius about 235.8 (circle_01, upper half only). A, E and B, D lie on circle_01; C does not (distance about 283 from O). Triangle-like construction: segments B-C (seg_03), A-B (seg_02), C-A (seg_05), and A-O (seg_04). E (292.5,110.7) lies on circle_01 and on segment BC (cross-product distance about 0.1 px), so E is the point where BC meets the semicircle. Right-angle marks verified at C (between CB and CA) and at A (angle BAD, with AD implied by the diameter; AD is not a drawn segment). circle_02 has low ink coverage (0.26) and fragmented arcs, and does not pass through E (distance 112 vs radius 149.5); treated as noise. All segments are solid; no dashed line found. Endpoints overshoot labelled vertices by 5-9 px and are snapped to the vertices.
